_inert_constants_removed_26aug2026.why: ISA-0432 Form 4. Each of these restated a quantity that derive_required_return.py DERIVES from the live portfolio value and the contribution schedule, and NOTHING on disk read any of them. A number sitting in a policy file that governs nothing is eventually read as though it governs something - which is exactly how the 13.9-vs-13.8 confusion reached Raj as a false decision.

thresholds._isa0427_note: Raised from 0.05 / 0.015-0.035 on 26-Aug-2026 IN THE SAME CHANGE as the V2.1 fixed ladder, per ISA_V2_1_BUILD_SPEC_CLEAN_23Aug2026.md s1. max_stock_position_pct is read at portfolio_analytics.py:377 as max_new_position_size and the ladder's EARNED_MAX (6.5%) breached the old 0.05 by 1.5pp. consistency_check.pair_stock_ladder_reconciles() asserts ladder max == max_stock_position_pct exactly, so the two can never drift again.

_stage1_probe_superseded_26aug2026.decision: Raj, 26-Aug-2026 (D5). The clean spec s1 - 'a position reaches 3.5% or it does not exist. No sub-scale holdings.' - is the build authority and supersedes the 0.75% Stage-1 probe pre-registered on 01-Aug-2026 in ISA_Stock_Sleeve_Confidence_Roadmap_Aug2026.md. The two were TWO HOMES FOR ONE RULE (D5, open since 22-Aug) and the ladder wins.
_stage1_probe_superseded_26aug2026.what_is_given_up: The staged de-risking ramp. This is a real cost, recorded rather than glossed: ISA-0429 measured the stock sleeve trailing VUAG by ~22pp ex-MU since April, so the caution the probe encoded was well founded. The replacement control is NOT size - it is QUALIFICATION (evidence state, s6) plus the correlation gate (s7) plus the step-down ratchet (s3). If those do not hold, nothing is protecting the sleeve, because the percentage ceiling was removed in the same change.
_stage1_probe_superseded_26aug2026.note: Retained as a record rather than deleted so a grep for stage1_probe_pct lands here.

thresholds._tier_caps_basis: Post-appreciation CONCENTRATION control on an OPEN direct-stock position — a different rule from the entry ladder, which is why both exist (cf. FLAG_FRACTION_OF_STARTER 0.75 vs MIN_ENTRY_FRACTION_OF_STARTER 0.80). Transcribed 28-Aug-2026 from Run_Context Standing Constraints so the rule has ONE home. ⚑⚑ ISA-0496 RESOLVED (Raj, 02-Sep-2026) — tier1_soft_cap_pct 5.0% is BELOW the ladder's EARNED_MAX 6.5%, so a top-rung position used to be in 'soft cap breached' the moment it opened, with a five-question FAIL trimming it to 3.5% and a Tier 2 breach trimming it to 5% — both BELOW what its evidence earned. NEITHER NUMBER MOVED. The TRIGGER became relative: position_sizing.effective_soft_cap_pct(evidence_state) = max(tier1_soft_cap_pct, that position's own earned ladder rung), and both remedies trim to that same figure. Nothing stops an EARNED_MAX position; a STARTER or NORMAL position is still reviewed at 5.0%, unchanged. Raising the cap flat to 6.5% was the simpler fix and was REJECTED: it would have deleted the drift control for every position below the top rung, letting a STARTER name triple without review. Enforced by consistency_check.pair_tier_caps_rung_aware().

stock_sleeve.sizing_ladder_basis: FIXED, not derived from any rung (Raj, 22-Aug-2026, Option 2). Applies to EVERY direct-stock position, forward-led and VCI alike. A position reaches 3.5% or it does not exist - there are no sub-scale holdings. The A1 diversification multiplier (x d) is WITHDRAWN: the ladder is the ladder.
stock_sleeve.evidence_state_to_rung_basis: A16 declares 'STRONG unlocks HIGH', which fixes the four measured states onto the four rungs. DEGRADED splits per Raj 26-Aug-2026 (ISA-0437 D13) because R2.10 forbids 'I could not measure it' and 'it is bad' producing the same output: DEGRADED_UNMEASURED holds at its current target, receives no new capital and does NOT enter challenger comparison (an unmeasured incumbent vs a measured challenger is decided by measurability, not quality), escalating to REVERSED after 2 consecutive failed runs; DEGRADED_REVERSED enters the pairwise comparison THAT RUN and trims to STARTER when no challenger qualifies.
stock_sleeve.sleeve_ceiling_basis: REMOVED as policy, 26-Aug-2026 (clean spec s2). Sleeve size is an OUTCOME, not a cap: it equals what qualifies x what it costs, bounded by the capital on offer. Removed with it: the Phase-1 10-15% band AS A CAP, A3's N_eff rung ladder, the Phase-1->Phase-2 transition test, and the one-new-position-per-run cap. Capital is the governor - at a GBP 156,321 post-subscription NAV a STARTER is GBP 5,471, so GBP 11,250 funds 2.06 positions and the arithmetic already binds. THE TRADE THIS MAKES: with no percentage ceiling, QUALIFICATION is the only thing between capital and a bad position, so the evidence state and the correlation gate are not refinements - they are the replacement control and must be live before this is safe at scale.
stock_sleeve.phase1_target_basis: RETAINED FOR REPORTING ONLY - phase1_target_low/high are no longer a cap on new capital. They remain as the band the monthly email reports position against, and phase1_target_low (10%) is the ratchet FLOOR in the s3 step-down rule.

stepdown_ratchet.replaces: the D6 probation rule at email_prefill.py:1514
stepdown_ratchet.population_basis: D18 (Raj, 27-Aug-2026). VCI INCLUDED - the ceiling is a capital question and VCI is the same capital. The superseded route filter could never have been true: no live producer emits route='forward_led' (the string occurs only in a selftest and two fixtures), so the published 'n=1, only COCO' was a FIXTURE result while the live filter returned 0 (F4 / ISA-0457).
stepdown_ratchet.trigger: THREE-LEG CONJUNCTION (D19), all three required: (a) trails VUAG by >=5pp; AND (b) trailed in >=9 of the last 12 measured months; AND (c) still trails by >=5pp with the LARGEST position excluded. Population >=3 open direct-stock positions is a precondition, not a leg.

trigger_legs.c_ex_largest_position: the largest position is read PER MONTH from freeze_history.largest_position_ticker and is NEVER hard-coded to MU - a hard-coded ex-MU leg becomes an ex-nothing leg the month MU is trimmed
trigger_legs.why_three: leg (a) alone is 0.1295 SD against a measured sleeve tracking error of 38.6%/yr and fires ~44% of the time on ZERO true alpha, at 6, 12 AND 24 months. Widening the window does not repair a threshold expressed in the units of the quantity rather than of its noise (R3.11). The conjunction is what buys discrimination.
trigger_legs.unmeasured_behaviour: ANY leg unmeasured => ACTIVE_UNMEASURED, never 'does not fire' (ISA-0429). The two spellings are asserted distinct.

stepdown_ratchet.basis: P5, built 29-Aug-2026. The population is every OPEN DIRECT-STOCK position including VCI (D18), which on the September book is 6. Route is still RECORDED - retention.route_attribution() buckets by route with pre_framework as its own bucket - but it is NON-GATING and makes NO counterfactual claim about whether a pre-framework position would have qualified (R2.2 bars a hypothesis from a decision). The rule still cannot fire before ~Aug-2027: freeze_history holds ONE measured month against the 12 leg (b) requires, and the pre-run prints which condition binds each month rather than reporting a bare 'cannot fire'.

funding_sources.basis: clean spec s4. stock_max is NOT capped at the band floor (ISA-0430): the reallocation_only semantics exempted a subscription from the freeze and then bound it to the band FLOOR, which is tighter than the unfrozen policy - GBP 548 against GBP 8,364, a 15.3x difference from one word.

stock_sleeve.cash_reserve_gbp_basis: RAJ D23, 02-Sep-2026 (ISA-0544). GBP 250 is retained as ISA cash and is the SINGLE control on residual deployment: deployable = max(residual - 250, 0), to funds or stocks alike. Raj's worked example: two whole positions funded, GBP 1,000 left, GBP 750 deployable. There is NO per-ticket top-up floor - `min_topup_gbp` is deliberately ABSENT and asserted absent, because two controls on one quantity is the FC-D two-homes class (R4.4, R14.2).

signal_logic.hold: Within band AND estimated return >= bucket minimum
signal_logic.watch_return: Within band BUT estimated return below bucket minimum (first time)
signal_logic.research_trigger: Within band BUT estimated return below bucket minimum 2+ consecutive months OR underperformed benchmark >3% over 12m AND below threshold
signal_logic.rebalancing_candidate: Outside band by > 2% — escalate to Step 10 Category 7

scaling_freeze.rule: sleeve must beat VUAG AND IWMO ex-MU over 4 consecutive months (A14 log); override unfreeze permitted at 3 via A13 entry
scaling_freeze.set_by: Institutional audit Jul-2026 item 4; window reduced 6->3-4 months by Raj 22-Jul-26

basis_semantics.reallocation_only: The freeze binds only capital whose SOURCE is a disposal from the fund sleeve. Capital from a subscription or from uninvested cash is not scaling and is not bound; its destination is decided by the demand-pull rule in `position_sizing.stock_max`, not by the Phase-1 band. The band remains a reporting and Phase-transition measure and is no longer a cap. (Raj, D20, 26-Aug-2026.) ⚑ REWRITTEN 28-Aug-2026 (P4.2). The previous text said stock_max 'is therefore the amount that restores the declared band FLOOR' — the ISA-0430 non-sequitur: the premise is about the SOURCE of capital and the conclusion was about its SIZE, and those do not follow. It derived GBP 547.94 on the September book, NOT_EXECUTABLE against a GBP 5,471.24 position, sending GBP 10,702.06 to a fund sleeve measured at 6.24% forward E[r] against a required 13.8-13.9%. The prior text is retained above under `_superseded_reallocation_only_pre_28aug2026` (R2.13). ⚑⚑ WHAT DOES **NOT** CHANGE: the freeze stays ACTIVE, and the ISA-0390 recall leg — trim funds to buy stocks — stays BARRED until 2026-11-01 (override) / 2026-12-01 (mechanical). D20 retires the band as a cap on SUBSCRIBED capital only.
basis_semantics.weight: stock_max holds the sleeve's PRE-SUBSCRIPTION weight exactly, so a subscription takes no new PROPORTIONAL exposure to the unproven process. Measured 20-Aug-2026 on the September case: GBP 891.90 = 0.591% of the post-subscription total, which is BELOW every declared position size in the framework (Stage-1 probe 0.75%, typical 1.5-3.5%, max 5.0%) — a cap that cannot fund a compliant new position, only a top-up. NOT CHOSEN, and the reason is recorded so the measurement is not lost.
basis_semantics.pounds: stock_max = 0. The freeze is an absolute bar on pounds entering the sleeve and the resulting dilution (0.591pp on the September case, repeating on every subscription) is ACCEPTED and recorded as a chosen cost. NOT CHOSEN.
basis_semantics._superseded_reallocation_only_pre_28aug2: The freeze binds only capital whose SOURCE is a DISPOSAL FROM THE FUND SLEEVE. A new subscription, and uninvested account cash, are not 'scaling' for the purposes of the freeze. stock_max is therefore the amount that restores the declared stock-sleeve band FLOOR, capped by the capital on offer. ⚑ CONSEQUENCE THAT TRAVELS WITH THE CHOICE: the ISA-0390 recall leg (trim funds -> buy stocks) IS a disposal from the fund sleeve and is therefore BARRED while the freeze is active, until 2026-11-01 (override) or 2026-12-01 (mechanical).

scaling_freeze.basis_note: ⚑ R4.4 / ISA-0387. This field declares the UNIT the freeze is measured in. The NUMBER is DERIVED by capital_destination.sleeve_split() from this basis on every run and is never typed here. Changing this string is the whole rollback.
